scope: Marty-owned digital passport preparation and controlled handoff; this contract does not attest physical personalization, a booklet, delivery, or travel-document acceptance

protocol_alignment.current_contract: The Marty Protocol physical_document_issuance Flow and physical_production Delivery Destination Profile remain unchanged. Their existing provider, target, credential, connector and conformance requirements still apply to that Flow
protocol_alignment.digital_only_status: A separate Marty Protocol draft proposes passport_digital_handoff with a marty_managed digital_handoff Delivery Destination Profile and privacy-safe evidence manifest. This UI freeze does not claim public protocol conformance until the 0.6 amendment is published and executable conformance passes. Beta-only acceptance may exercise an exact reviewed, versioned 0.6 candidate behind feature negotiation before public publication
protocol_alignment.required_amendment: Before digital_package_prepared can count as beta evidence, merge the separately reviewed Marty Protocol proposal, then promote its exact reviewed schemas, enums, specs, profile, conformance fixtures and generated bindings into a pinned 0.6.0-beta.1 candidate manifest. Record its commit and every promoted file hash; require exact X-MIP-Version negotiation plus digital-handoff capability and readiness across all beta components, behind a beta-only feature flag, and pass executable conformance. Proposal merge alone is insufficient. Public 0.6 release and conformance claims follow aggregate beta acceptance. Do not relabel physical_document_issuance or relax its physical-production requirements
protocol_alignment.repository_boundary: No marty-protocol file is changed by this UI contract

package_manifest.digest_encoding: All SHA-256 fields in the schema are 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters over the named exact bytes; services_oci_digest is sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
package_manifest.canonicalization: Encode the private manifest as RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme UTF-8 bytes with no floating-point values, then SHA-256 those exact bytes. Hash the ciphertext envelope separately after encrypting the manifest and package payload to avoid a self-referential digest
package_manifest.immutability: Once a package is accepted for handoff, the exact manifest and SOD bytes are immutable; a changed document, certificate, selected issuer profile record, or SOD creates a new reviewed package revision rather than silently updating the accepted one
package_manifest.source_binding: Every field and encrypted artifact chunk belongs to the same authenticated organization and durable source job; organization, application, Flow execution, credential template, application template and delivery destination identifiers match that job, trusted durable Flow state, artifact-seal attestation and final completion receipt. A step-7 receipt alone cannot establish handoff readiness. A foreign tenant, job, template, destination, or chunk fails closed
package_manifest.flow_binding: A caller-supplied flow_execution_id copied into the passport job is not evidence. The private verifier must retrieve the actual Flow instance and step history through a trusted authenticated Flow read and protected signed receipts derived from that durable Flow record, never from a caller assertion. It must verify the same organization, instance ID, source job ID and application ID, credential_template_id, application_template_id and delivery_destination_profile_id against both the durable job and trusted Flow definition and the reviewed beta-versioned passport_digital_handoff Flow. Step 6 must verify the exact package; step 7 must seal the encrypted handoff artifact before a trusted artifact-seal Flow attestation is signed. The UI private manifest stores artifact_seal_flow_attestation_sha256 over those exact signed bytes. Step 8 then succeeds, and a separate protected final Flow completion receipt outside that manifest proves all eight draft_step_sequence steps executed in order and terminal COMPLETED status. A protected release attestation binds both receipt digests, the encrypted private-manifest envelope digest and opaque handoff reference without a hash cycle. The verifier checks all three signatures and the same-job, revision, SOD and artifact bindings. Configured steps, capability listings, a matching stored string or a simulated physical Flow are insufficient
package_manifest.issuer_profile_binding: For each distinct CSCA and DSC identity, registry_revision is the shared organization issuer-profile registry document revision at resolution, not a per-profile revision. profile_record_sha256 is SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the selected public profile record; kms_key_reference_sha256 hashes the exact UTF-8 reference in that record. public_key_spki_sha256 and certificate_sha256 hash complete DER bytes; custody_receipt_sha256 hashes the protected signed custody receipt. Retrieve the selected records from the attested registry revision or authenticated immutable snapshot and verify signed custody receipts and current KMS public keys. Each KMS SPKI must match its certificate SPKI; profile certificate hashes must equal private CSCA/DSC certificate hashes. The DSC custody receipt binds the selected profile and KMS key to exact SOD DER digest; CSCA receipt binds its profile and key to exact DSC certificate digest. A changed selected record, key, cert or missing receipt fails closed. An unrelated registry edit alone does not imply a changed selected profile
package_manifest.sod_binding: Verify the signature, embedded DSC, active organization CSCA chain and every issued data-group hash against the exact DER SOD in the encrypted package. Capture the exact signed material for every package candidate, including the frozen direct submit-personalization from DRAFT where sod_sha256 may be null; that direct route remains compatible but cannot establish the draft digital-only Flow claim without its executed eight-step sequence. A prior generate-sod response digest may differ because later submission may re-sign; that difference is allowed. The final package SOD DER digest must equal the digest of the exact SOD DER bytes handed off. Neither a prior generate-sod call nor its response digest is sufficient
package_manifest.data_group_binding: The draft digital-only protocol claim is TD3 with DG1 and DG2 required and any additional DG number limited to 3 through 16. Verify every data group present in the package and the exact SOD's complete data-group hash map; the two private maps must match. The frozen nine-route API still accepts TD1, TD2 and wider DG numbers for compatibility, but those inputs cannot satisfy this draft digital-only claim without a separately reviewed protocol amendment
package_manifest.mrz_binding: Validate TD3 MRZ format and check digits and compare the MRZ represented in DG1 with the handed-off MRZ. Hash the exact 44 ASCII bytes of line 1 followed immediately by the exact 44 ASCII bytes of line 2, with no separator or trailing byte, for mrz_sha256; apply the same 88-byte encoding to the DG1-extracted MRZ for dg1_mrz_sha256. Both private digests must match. A string-only request validation result is insufficient
package_manifest.encryption: Use the existing non-exportable Transit artifact key and frozen chunk binding to organization_id, artifact_id, chunk_index and chunk_count. For the source artifact, artifact_id is source_job_id; for the handoff package, derive a domain-separated artifact_id from source_job_id and package revision. source_encrypted_artifact_manifest_sha256 names the source payload chunk manifest already recorded by the durable job; handoff_encrypted_artifact_manifest_sha256 names the final handoff payload chunk manifest. Both are SHA-256 over canonical manifest bytes and neither is the digest of this private manifest or of its own ciphertext envelope. Verify each against the corresponding stored encrypted artifact and round-trip both under the same tenant before accepting handoff. Encrypt this private manifest separately after its fields are finalized. Authenticate and decrypt only inside an authorized private handoff verifier; never expose plaintext package material in a public route, log, or uploaded acceptance report

protocol_evidence_projection.boundary: The UI manifest and the draft protocol private manifest are authorized private encrypted evidence. The public passport-digital-handoff-package schema contains only a random opaque handoff_reference, the digest of the encrypted private manifest envelope, the digest of a protected signed attestation, and creation time; it must contain no raw or unkeyed MRZ, DG, SOD, certificate, source-job, or ciphertext-artifact digest and no bearer-capable artifact URL
protocol_evidence_projection.identity_mapping: Match organization_id, source_job_id, flow_execution_id, application_id, credential_template_id, application_template_id and delivery_destination_profile_id across the durable job, trusted Flow definition and execution, UI private manifest, artifact-seal attestation and draft protocol private manifest before publication. Map UI artifact_seal_flow_attestation_sha256 exactly to the protocol private field of the same name. Map UI csca_issuer_profile and dsc_issuer_profile to protocol private issuer_profile_bindings.csca and issuer_profile_bindings.document_signer with every ID, shared registry revision, record/KMS key/SPKI/certificate and signed custody-receipt digest intact; independently verify the corresponding protected records, receipts and KMS public keys. Generate a new random UUID handoff_reference bound privately to source_job_id and package revision. No source or applicant identifiers are copied into the public object
protocol_evidence_projection.document_mapping: Inside the authorized private verifier only, map the matching TD3 document and 88-byte MRZ digests, complete DG and SOD DG maps, exact SOD DER digest, DSC and CSCA DER digests into the draft protocol private manifest. Prefix each UI private map key 1..16 with DG to form the protocol private key DG1..DG16; preserve the exact one-to-one entries and reject duplicate, aliased, missing or extra keys. Never project these digests into the public handoff object
protocol_evidence_projection.receipt_mapping: Inside the authorized private verifier, bind protected chain verification, source and handoff encrypted artifact round trips, quality approval, release lineage and the exact private manifest digest to the same organization, source job, Flow execution and package revision. Sign the artifact-seal Flow attestation after step 7 and record its digest in the private manifest. Sign a separate final Flow completion receipt after step 8, outside the private manifest. Encrypt the finalized private manifest separately, then sign a release attestation binding the final receipt, artifact-seal attestation, encrypted private-manifest envelope digest and random handoff_reference. Publish only that reference, SHA-256 of the encrypted private manifest envelope, SHA-256 of the signed release attestation, and created_at. The public reference is an identifier, not a bearer token, and cannot grant artifact access
protocol_evidence_projection.not_proof_by_shape: Passing either JSON Schema proves shape only. Before step 8, the verifier must recompute private digests, verify source and handoff artifacts and issuer/Flow lineage, compare the two complete DG maps and MRZ digests, and validate source, chain, quality and artifact-seal receipts. After step 8, the separate final Flow completion receipt and bound release attestation must verify before publication or digital_package_prepared

digital_quality_review.reviewer: An organization-authorized reviewer distinct from the package preparer and certificate ceremony operators
digital_quality_review.binding: The review names the exact package-manifest digest, organization, source job, package revision, checks performed, decision and time; a decision on another package or a boolean without source evidence is invalid
digital_quality_review.attestation: A protected workflow verifies the reviewer's governed identity and distinctness, signs the review artifact, and binds it to the exact protected source, release image and private package-manifest digest
digital_quality_review.failure: A rejected, absent, stale, or self-reviewed package cannot satisfy digital_package_prepared

private_verification_outcomes.success: Emit a digest-bound digital_package_prepared receipt only after every required same-job proof and independent approved review passes
private_verification_outcomes.schema_or_digest_invalid: Reject the package; emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.tenant_job_application_flow_template_or_: Reject before disclosing package content; verify authenticated context and ciphertext binding before decryption, then compare the decrypted manifest with the durable source job and trusted Flow definition. Emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.flow_attestation_missing_forged_or_unexe: Reject the digital claim unless trusted Flow state, artifact-seal attestation, final eight-step completion receipt and bound release attestation all verify, even when the caller-supplied ID matches the passport job. Emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.sod_dg_mrz_or_chain_invalid: Reject the package; emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.artifact_decryption_or_chunk_binding_fai: Reject the package; emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.review_missing_rejected_stale_or_not_ind: Reject the package; emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.kms_or_issuer_profile_unavailable: Fail closed and retry only with the same source job and an explicitly versioned package; emit no handoff receipt and do not change the frozen public job status
private_verification_outcomes.simulator_or_physical_handoff_absent: No effect on digital_package_prepared; retain a separate compatibility result and physical_claim=not_claimed

optional_physical_paperwork_handoff.separate_claim: The digital package may be prepared, reviewed and accepted with no physical paperwork handoff configured or performed. If later requested, a physical handoff or booklet receipt has its own provider provenance and acceptance; it does not alter or retroactively prove the digital claim
optional_physical_paperwork_handoff.simulator: The beta bureau remains a non-physical route-parity fixture. Its SHIPPED or DELIVERED status, tracking number, signed callback, and operator quality-verify decision cannot prove a physical booklet

acceptance_evidence.separate_compatibility_gate: Before Python retirement, exercise all nine frozen Gateway and Flow routes plus bureau batch, poll and signed callback behavior with an isolated simulator or fixture, including tenant binding and negative signature cases. This preserves Python feature parity but is separate from, and cannot be used as evidence for, digital_package_prepared
acceptance_evidence.sanitized_report: Publish only fixed probe outcomes, a random opaque handoff reference, nonreversible keyed commitments for any necessary identifiers, approved source and image lineage, the encrypted private-manifest envelope digest, the protected signed-attestation digest, a reviewer attestation reference, and explicit physical_claim=not_claimed. Exclude raw identifiers and their unkeyed hashes, plaintext private-manifest digest, MRZ/DG/SOD/certificate digests or bytes, ciphertext artifact digests, credentials, and decrypted artifacts from uploaded reports
